incident-bot: :rotating_light: Auto-page: streaming.tail_latency.p99 breached in eu-west-2 (p99=1.82s, SLO=0.9s) — increased streaming stalls and client timeouts observed. Auto-runbooks: streaming-tail-triage. Oncall: jamie
jamie: taking this — oncall takeover. pulling graphs now. tagging net-eng if cross-zone issues look likely :phone:
sylvia: oncall handoff ack, dashboards up. p95 also trending up. Logs show spike at 12:12 UTC, sustained ~6m. customer-facing alert queued to support.
carl: pinging — seeing NAT conn churn between AZB->AZC, TLS handshake retransmits increase. probable egress path issue. pulling tcp stats.
net-eng-bot: short telemetry dump: tls_syn_retransmit_rate: 0.14 -> 0.48, dns_retries: +3200, nat_conn_age_median drop, route-change events +5 in last 5m.
maria: support: initial customer triage: ~14 customers with degraded streaming tail, 3 reporting session disconnects. top affected clusters: eu-west2-azb/azc. No broad data loss but increased latency and stalls.
sylvia: can we confirm cross-zone packet loss? packet loss graphs show blips ~1-2% between AZB->AZC at 12:10-12:18. that would explain TLS handshake timeouts.
carl: running quick tcpdump on nat-gw-azb:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host 10.5.23.45 and tcp port 443 -w /tmp/handshake.pcap
# seeing retransmits, dup acks
```
jamie: runbook step 3: try egress reroute to alternate NAT pool (azb -> azd) and increase ephemeral port range temporarily. anyone can flip route?
net-eng-bot: recommending gradual traffic steer to azd to avoid cache warmup. suggest 30% -> 60% -> drain.
carl: starting 30% reroute via azd now. applying NAT port expansion + bump conn-tracking timeout:
```
sudo iptables -t nat -I POSTROUTING -o eth1 -j MASQUERADE --random
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=86400
```
sylvia: scaling streaming gateways in eu-west2 by +2 pods to absorb tail spikes. also enabling aggressive prefix KV cache for hot callers.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered by sylvia: scale streaming-gateway eu-west2 +2 (strategy: no-bounce).
maria: support: customer notice sent to active incidents list; PS team alerted for top 3 customers. asking for ETA.
jamie: monitoring p99 and error budget burn. initial p99 dropped from 1.82s -> 1.05s after 30% shift. still above SLO but trending. continuing ramp.
carl: after 60% via azd, p99 -> 0.88s, p95 -> 0.32s. TLS retransmits back to baseline. packet loss reduced to <0.2%. looks like azb egress path had transient packet loss/queueing.
sylvia: leaving extra telemetry collection on for next 2 hours (pcap + packet counters). opening ticket with cloud provider for azb egress path (provider ticket ID TBD).
jamie: customer impact summary for postmortem: brief SLO breach (~9m), 14 customers degraded, 3 session disconnects, no data corruption. mitigation: egress steer to azd, NAT ephemeral port bump, scale gateways, enable cache.
net-eng-bot: creating internal ticket and attaching pcap + metrics. priority P1 -> vendor engagement.
maria: support: will follow up with affected customers with timeline and mitigation notes.
sylvia: handing off to carl/net-eng for follow-up and vendor coordination. jamie keeping incident open for final confirmation and postmortem.
jamie: thanks all. leaving page for 1 hour post-mitigation then will close if stable. adding postmortem owners: sylvia + carl + maria. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Incident created: INC-171860-01, severity: SEV2, channel: #incidents.
incident-bot: Remember to attach runbook run logs and the reroute commands to the ticket.
jamie: closing update in 55m unless regressions. great quick work everyone. :heart:
